info.name: Euler Data API (V3) Accounts Tokens API

params.name: chainId
params.description: Comma-separated list of chain IDs (single value allowed).

params.name: address
params.description: Filter by a token address. May be repeated. Combine with chainId for the fastest lookup path. Counts toward the 100-address filter cap. When address filters are present and limit is omitted, the default limit is the requested address count capped at 100.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Filter by comma-separated token addresses. May be repeated. Maximum 100 addresses. Combine with chainId for the fastest lookup path. When address filters are present and limit is omitted, the default limit is the requested address count capped at 100.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include.

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested token page size. Values above 500 are clamped.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by token classification. Comma-separated values: base, debt, unitOfAccount, oracleAsset, reward, swapAsset
